title: Shopify store examples: one theme, five stores | Impression
description:
One Shopify theme, five stores that look nothing alike. We tapped through the real demo stores of Impression, one UTD theme with five presets:

• Etoile — fashion: start typing, and matching products show up as you type
• Reflex — accessories: product tabs that switch the shelf in one tap
• Impression — art: the same painting shown in different rooms
• Felix — pet supplies: FAQ sorted by topic, answers one tap away
• Mimi — kids: scroll the room, tap a piece to see the product

Same theme underneath. You change the style, not the platform.

Impression is in the official Shopify Theme Store. Try it free, with no time limit; you pay only when you publish your store.
👉 https://themes.shopify.com/themes?q=utd

Voiceover is AI-generated.
